name: neuralscape
description: Persistent agentic memory for Claude Code and Claude Cowork. Multi-user support: each user has personal memory (only they can read it) plus access to a shared team knowledge pool and an optional authoritative 'standard' tier of org rules and selectable team processes set by a designated dictator. In Claude Code, plugin hooks auto-capture conversations + per-tool observations and recall context on session start; in Claude Cowork (which does not run plugin hooks), the cross-platform recall/remember/save-session/project/ingest/process skills drive the same loop through the MCP connector. The ingest skill loads files, folders, or pasted context (Markdown/HTML/PDF/MS-Office) into memory; the process skill runs a defined team process and pulls its standards. Exposes 14 MCP tools (recall_memories, remember, remember_conversation, ingest_document, ingest_text, get_project_context, search_knowledge_graph, list_memories, list_projects, list_processes, get_process, delete_memories, edit_memory, retag_memories).

URL.title: Neuralscape service URL
URL.description: Base URL of your Neuralscape API (e.g. https://neuralscape.example.com or http://localhost:8199).

API_KEY.title: Bearer token (per-user) or legacy shared API key
API_KEY.description: For multi-user deployments, this is your per-user token issued by the admin via `scripts/issue_user_token.py --user <name>`. The token encodes your user_id; the server reads it from the token, not from the body. For legacy single-user deployments, this is the shared NEURALSCAPE_API_KEY. Leave empty for local dev.

USER_ID.title: Your user ID
USER_ID.description: Stable identifier used to scope memories to you. When using a per-user token, this must match the user_id encoded in the token (or be left empty — the token wins). Required for legacy shared-key auth.

COMPILE_THRESHOLD.title: Compile threshold (observations)
COMPILE_THRESHOLD.description: Buffer size that triggers in-session compilation via UserPromptSubmit. Default: 25.

COMPILE_AGE_MIN.title: Compile age (minutes)
COMPILE_AGE_MIN.description: Buffer age (oldest entry) that triggers in-session compilation. Default: 30.

CONTEXT_MODE.title: SessionStart context mode
CONTEXT_MODE.description: 'index' (default) injects a budget-bounded, day-grouped memory index with an escalation footer (progressive disclosure); 'full' restores the legacy full-content injection.

INDEX_BUDGET_TOKENS.title: Index budget (tokens)
INDEX_BUDGET_TOKENS.description: Approximate token budget for the SessionStart memory index table. Default: 1500.

CODE_GRAPH.title: Code-graph deferral
CODE_GRAPH.description: 'auto' (default) probes the service for a resolvable Graphify code graph at session start and, when found, teaches code-structure questions to defer to the NS code-graph tools; 'on' skips the probe and always teaches it; 'off' disables it.

READ_GATE_ENABLED.title: File read gate
READ_GATE_ENABLED.description: 'true' (default) enables the PreToolUse gate on Read: large files that already have Neuralscape memories get a ranked per-file memory timeline instead of a raw read (re-Read the same path to override). 'false' disables it.

READ_GATE_MIN_BYTES.title: Read gate minimum file size (bytes)
READ_GATE_MIN_BYTES.description: Files at or below this size are never gated. Default: 1500.

EXCLUDED_PROJECTS.title: Excluded projects (globs)
EXCLUDED_PROJECTS.description: Comma-separated project-id globs (e.g. 'scratch-*,secret?') the plugin must never capture from or inject into. Honored by every capturing hook. NS_EXCLUDED_PROJECTS env var works as an alias.

SKIP_TOOLS.title: Extra tools to skip in observation capture
SKIP_TOOLS.description: Comma-separated tool names added to the built-in PostToolUse skip list (Read/Glob/Grep/TodoWrite/Skill/ToolSearch/AskUserQuestion/etc.).

FAIL_LOUD_THRESHOLD.title: Fail-loud threshold (consecutive failures)
FAIL_LOUD_THRESHOLD.description: After this many consecutive Neuralscape-unreachable events, SessionStart shows an explicit 'unreachable for N events — check docker compose ps' notice instead of the generic degrade line. Default: 3.
